name: Portobello Mushroom Tuna Melts with Baby Greens

instructions.primary_message: Preheat broiler and position rack about 15 cm from the top.
Wash and dry mushrooms; remove stems. Place mushroom caps on a baking sheet pan and brush with a little olive oil. Place in the oven and broil until almost tender, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Small dice mushroom stems and transfer to a large bowl.

Wash and dry celery and parsley. Small dice and add the celery to bowl with mushrooms. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to bowl. Peel, mince, and add garlic to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle tuna with lemon juice and olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and slice tomatoes into rounds.
Remove the mushrooms from the oven. Divide tuna mixture evenly among the mushrooms and stuff inside. Top with tomato slices and sprinkle mozzarella over top.
Return to oven and broil until cheese melts and begins to turn golden brown, 2-3 minutes.

instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Arrange a bed of mixed greens on a plate and place mushroom caps on top. Enjoy!
